about.hero_subtitle: At Cahan Academy, we strive to instill the latest technologies and knowledge in our students.
about.history_desc_1: Starting in 2020 with a small team, Cahan Academy has quickly become one of the region's leading technology training centers.
about.history_desc_2: Today, we are a large family with hundreds of graduates, led by industry experts.
about.mission_desc: To create an accessible and high-quality educational environment for everyone wanting to build a career in technology.
about.vision_desc: To be the largest education and innovation center contributing to the development of the technological ecosystem in Azerbaijan.
about.value_quality_desc: Our training programs are prepared in accordance with international standards.
about.value_innovation_desc: We always apply the latest technologies and methodologies.
about.value_student_desc: Our graduates finding jobs and growing is our top priority.
about.team_subtitle: Field experts working to provide you with the best education.

faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our academy, courses, and registration process.
faq.meta_description: Frequently asked questions and answers about Cahan Academy.
faq.still_desc: If your answer is not here, write to us and our team will reply.

fallback.q: How do I enrol in a course?
fallback.a: Press “Enroll Now” on the course page and fill in the form. Our team will get in touch with you.

fallback.q: Where can I find a course’s price and duration?
fallback.a: Each course page shows its price, duration and level. For anything else, write to us through the contact form.

fallback.q: Where can I learn about the teachers?
fallback.a: The “Teachers” section has a profile for every teacher, with their field and the courses they teach.
Fill in the form on the “Contact” page, or use the phone number and e-mail address listed there.

home.features_lead: Not just a course — an experience that changes careers.
home.f1_desc: Strengthen your career with certificates that follow international standards.
home.f2_desc: Learn through real projects and hands-on tasks, not theory alone.
home.f3_desc: One-to-one mentoring sessions and ongoing support from professional teachers.
home.f4_desc: Connect with 1200+ students, exchange ideas and grow together.
home.f5_desc: Weekday evenings or weekends — learn when it suits you.
home.f6_desc: More than 8 years of professional education and certification in Azerbaijan.
home.path_lead: Four simple steps from application to your first lesson.
home.step1_desc: Find the direction and level that fit you on the courses page.
home.step2_desc: Fill in the short form: your name, contact details and the course you chose.
home.step3_desc: Our team reviews your application and agrees the details with you.
home.step4_desc: Join practical lessons with your teacher and apply what you learn in projects.
home.courses_empty_desc: The course list could not be loaded right now. Open the courses page or check back a little later.
home.cta_text: Write to us for a free consultation, and we will find the course that suits you together.
